localFileOpening.completion: Successful spawn responds with empty result; detached waiter reaps opener, not GUI application completion.
localFileOpening.validationScope: Rust validator fixtures and real stdio host with test-owned PATH opener; no actual LaunchServices/GUI acceptance.

launchFieldResolution.normalization: non_empty_env uses env::var; invalid Unicode or absent is None; Unicode whitespace is trimmed and empty results are absent.
launchFieldResolution.precedence: Normalized nonempty environment values override already-selected config fields. No raw JSON parsing is implemented by this module.
launchFieldResolution.port: u16 parse accepts zero and a plus sign; invalid/overflow environment input falls back to selected config port then zero.
launchFieldResolution.integrationStatus: Resolver library only; not yet wired to runtime selection/spawn. Schema-2 registry matching and raw configuration parsing remain open.

manifestValidation.schema: JSON positive integer 2, not floating 2.0 or string 2. Array order and unknown entry fields preserved; candidate failure policy not yet implemented.
manifestValidation.pathContract: entry.paths[field] must be a nonempty trimmed string with successful metadata; follows symlinks and accepts directories. No executable or absolute-path requirement in this helper.
manifestValidation.integrationStatus: Validation primitives composed by select_entry; process launch remains separate.

manifestIdentityMatching.semantics: Only supplied constraints are checked. All supplied constraints must match. String-array membership is exact; nonstrings ignored and duplicate matches add weight once. Paths compare components first, then both canonical paths on mismatch; no trimming.
manifestIdentityMatching.integrationStatus: Identity stage composed by select_entry with protocol/path checks and ranking; process startup remains separate.

manifestViabilityAndRanking.protocolSemantics: Supplied requirements demand exact u64 equality. Missing/invalid/older gives native mismatch discriminant 2; either candidate protocol newer gives discriminant 1. Core names describe comparison, not unverified wire codes.
manifestViabilityAndRanking.presenceSemantics: One point for presence.pid representable as u64, including zero. This stage does not check OS process liveness.
manifestViabilityAndRanking.rankingSemantics: Higher score first; equal score compares untrimmed updatedAt strings lexically, missing/nonstring becomes empty. Equal keys keep first entry. No date parser.
manifestViabilityAndRanking.integrationStatus: Native helper stages composed by select_entry with raw extraction and error retention; runtime launch integration remains open.

manifestConfigurationExtraction.normalization: Entry and paths must be objects. String fields use Unicode trim; empty/missing/nonstring becomes None. No path join or existence check in extraction.
manifestConfigurationExtraction.protocols: Optional u64 protocol values; zero allowed, float/string/negative rejected.
manifestConfigurationExtraction.proxyPortSemantics: Only integer 1..65535 retained. Zero becomes absent, unlike the separate environment u16 resolver.
manifestConfigurationExtraction.integrationStatus: Raw extraction composed by select_entry; environment resolution and process startup remain separate.

manifestSelection.semantics: Validate schema before identity filtering. Skip identity misses. Retain protocol mismatch with newer-candidate priority. Retain last required-path failure. Rank successfully extracted candidates. Winner takes precedence over retained nonfatal errors; otherwise last path error, then retained protocol error, then no-compatible-entry. Schema/malformed extraction failures abort immediately.
manifestSelection.integrationStatus: Composed in-memory schema-2 selection with real path metadata checks. Registry discovery/read, schema-1 fallback, environment precedence and runtime process integration remain open.

registryPathDiscovery.semantics: First HOME (or USERPROFILE when absent)/Library/Application Support/OpenAI/Codex/registry. Then CODEX_HOME/registry, or HOME/USERPROFILE plus .codex/registry when CODEX_HOME absent. var_os preserves empty/whitespace/non-Unicode; no deduplication or file reads.
registryPathDiscovery.integrationStatus: Path discovery implemented. Multi-file read/error fallback and schema-1/runtime integration remain open.

registryFileLoading.semantics: First successfully selected registry wins. Missing files ignored; other read/parse/schema errors remembered while trying later files. If none succeeds: last required-path error, then protocol mismatch with newer priority, then last read/parse/schema error, then no-compatible if a file was read or missing-registry otherwise.
registryFileLoading.scope: Actual UTF-8 file reads and existing selector; no schema-1 fallback, environment resolution or process launch yet. Tests use owned temporary files only.

adjacentConfiguration.semantics: Only reached after v2 registry selection succeeds. Parent-of-current-exe sidecar supplies seven missing launch strings and nonzero u16 proxyPort. Reader ignores missing/unreadable/invalid JSON/nonobject; no schemaVersion gate. Registry values precede supplementary values. Does not rescue missing/incompatible v2 registry.
adjacentConfiguration.integrationStatus: File loading and supplementation composed; final environment composition and process launch remain open.

composedConfigurationLoading.semantics: Discovery -> first usable registry -> adjacent missing-field supplementation -> environment resolution. Invocation extension ID filters candidates and is the fallback final ID; nonempty CODEX_EXTENSION_ID changes only final launch ID. Registry failure returns before launch-environment resolution.
composedConfigurationLoading.scope: Composed loader with caller-supplied executable and environment accessor; no runtime manager or process spawn integration yet.

runtimeErrorResponse.contract: JSON-RPC 2.0, original ID, error.code=1, original error message, error.data.type from native enum table. Newer candidate protocol maps to chrome_extension_update_required; older/missing to codex_app_update_required.
runtimeErrorResponse.integrationStatus: Manifest error conversion and response serializer implemented. Runtime hello/status/ensure/restart dispatcher not yet wired.

managerStatus.semantics: No proxy: {phase:idle}; existing proxy: {phase:connected,runtimeSessionId:<cloned string>}. No configuration load, process spawn or PID health probe occurs in status. Empty strings remain strings.
managerStatus.integrationStatus: Status projection only. Not registered as a live control method until real proxy lifecycle exists; never fabricate a connected state from configuration.

processCommand.semantics: Bare one-component program retains PATH search; other relative program paths resolve against host cwd. Arguments app-server and --analytics-default-enabled. All three stdio streams piped. Optional codexHome resolves relative to host cwd, create_dir_all, child cwd and CODEX_HOME. Other environment inherited.
processCommand.integrationStatus: Command construction and raw child spawn tested against an owned fake executable. Process reuse, launch-error decoration, stderr drain, proxy/read threads, stop and manager/dispatcher integration remain incomplete.

childStopAndWait.semantics: Option<Arc<Mutex<Child>>> stop: absent succeeds; poisoned lock is an I/O Other error; try_wait error propagates; already exited succeeds; live child kill then wait. Kill InvalidInput (Darwin EINVAL=22 maps to native kind 0x14) is ignored; other kill errors propagate. Wait helper discards exit status and holds child mutex through wait.
childStopAndWait.integrationStatus: Owned-process tests cover live stop/reap, repeated stop, absent child, nonzero exit and poison error. No production manager wiring or full thread shutdown yet.

stderrWorker.semantics: 8192-byte BufReader, lines iteration; read/UTF-8 errors terminate silently. Whitespace-only lines skipped, original untrimmed String printed with extension-host: app-server stderr: prefix and newline. Worker detached after creation.
stderrWorker.integrationStatus: Worker and stream consumer implemented, tested with >1 MiB through a real owned child pipe. Lifecycle owner must take stderr and invoke worker; raw spawn still exposes all three pipes.

stdoutReplay.contract: Strip trailing CR/LF only. Cache raw initialize result with exact reserved ID, absent method and present result. When unattached buffer first 128 method-string messages with an ID field, including null IDs. Generation mismatch does not mutate replay state. Raw text is retained.
stdoutReplay.integrationStatus: Replay helpers tested, not a complete stdout worker. Writer selection, websocket writes, error detach and EOF state cleanup remain to be connected.

websocketWriter.semantics: Mutex covers header and payload write_all. FIN OR opcode; no masking; lengths <126, <65536, otherwise u64 big endian. No helper-level opcode/control-frame validation. Close attempts empty opcode-8 frame then reacquires lock and shuts down both directions, ignoring errors.
websocketWriter.integrationStatus: Actual TCP frame boundaries and 400 concurrent frames tested. Handshake, frame reader, authorization and complete stdout worker remain separate work.

composedOutputDelivery.semantics: Cache initialize, then select same-generation writer under state lock; write outside lock. Failed write detaches only pointer-identical Arc and does not requeue that frame. Without selected writer, apply request replay rules. Mutex poison does not recover state.
composedOutputDelivery.integrationStatus: Per-line composition tested with real TCP and write shutdown. Reader loop, lifecycle EOF cleanup, attach replay and manager integration remain incomplete.

stdoutReadLoop.contract: Reuse a cleared String and 8192-byte BufReader; forward each successful nonzero read, including final unterminated line. Read/UTF-8 failure exits. Native thread waits for child only after forwarding and its cleanup return.
stdoutReadLoop.integrationStatus: Real owned child stdout -> Rust line delivery -> TCP websocket frame tested. Reader returns errors to owner; native diagnostic logging and lifecycle EOF cleanup still pending.
